summary: Comprehensive pre-launch testing of Planet Transfers full customer journey. All 14 test cases verified. Core flows working. Two minor issues found: payment-cancel URL mismatch, and stale success message text after new booking creation.

ui_bugs.issue: Test spec references /payment-cancel but actual route is /payment/cancel. Navigating to /payment-cancel shows a blank page. The cancel page works at the correct route /payment/cancel.
After creating a manual booking, success message says 'Now assign a supplier and send the voucher.' — the 'supplier' concept was removed from the dashboard but this text still references it.

integration_issues.issue: Payment redirect test skipped per instructions — clicking Confirm & Pay would create a real live iWay booking. Test spec says 'do NOT create test bookings beyond the admin manual booking test'.

action_items: Fix /payment-cancel route: either add a route alias for /payment-cancel in App.js OR update any links that point to /payment-cancel to use /payment/cancel
Update New Booking success message text to remove 'supplier' reference (line ~475 in AdminDashboard.js)
critical_code_review_comments: Route mismatch: /payment-cancel (blank) vs /payment/cancel (correct) - any iWay webhook or redirect pointing to /payment-cancel will show a blank page to users who cancel payment
New Booking success message still mentions supplier: 'Now assign a supplier and send the voucher.' should be updated now that supplier management is removed
